notes: City of Austin base zoning districts (Zoning_1 service, layer 0; ZONING_BASE is the base district family, e.g. SF, LO, CS; ZONING_ZTYPE is the full district incl. overlays such as -CO, -NP). Covers Austin city limits and portions of Travis County; unincorporated county land and other cities are not in this layer. No zone name or ordinance link field in this layer.
